quote: Graphically, the game is unbelievable! Technical performance….’little lacking. The frame rate needs to be a consistent 30 FPS, not a “targeted” frame rate.

author: MetaNJ52
quote: No words can describe just how good this timeless remake is! Nintendo knocked it out of the park by a long mile!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: MetaNJ52
quote: Same as the Nintendo Switch version, but with better graphics. The graphical upgrade is a real improvement to showcase the beauty of each Star Wars location.
game_title: LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga

author: MetaNJ52
quote: This is a really good Lego version of the Skywalker Saga. The worlds are so full of life and the characters are whimsical and very fun to play. I enjoyed collecting all of the Kyber Bricks and playing through each of the episodic adventures.
game_title: LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga

author: MetaNJ52
quote: I am thoroughly enjoying this remaster. The Series S version of this game is amazing and I really appreciate how the console handles this game.  Shadow controls amazingly well, and each of the levels are very well – designed. I made a slight error on Kingdom Valley: Act One, and was able to course correct.
